  local op_vault op_env

  case "$op_vault" in ''|'<vault>'|'<'*) echo "Pre-flight: OP_VAULT not resolved in $template_file; deferring to op inject."; return 0 ;; esac
  case "$op_env" in ''|'<environment>'|'<'*) echo "Pre-flight: OP_ENV not resolved in $template_file; deferring to op inject."; return 0 ;; esac
